{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.16

|eff= local

|gr1= Curator

|descr= Force opens curator interface.

|s1= [[openCuratorInterface]]

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= Open interface:
<sqf>openCuratorInterface;</sqf>

|x2= Close interface:
<sqf>findDisplay 312 closeDisplay 2;</sqf>

|x3= Detect if user used "Zeus" key to open curator interface in the absence of event handler for it:
<sqf>
findDisplay 46 displayAddEventHandler ["KeyDown", {
	if (inputAction "CuratorInterface" > 0) then
	{
		hint "Curator interface is open";
	};
	false
}];
</sqf>

|seealso= [[Arma 3: Curator]]
}}
